purpose: Review criteria for plan documents: lists the SSOT documents to check by priority, the order of checks, and the rules for deciding recommendations, delegating norms and severity to principles.
summary: Delegates norms and severity to principles; this file holds no judgment itself
SSOT reference table with P1/P2/P3 priorities, doc types and roles
P1 rule conformance order: plan principles, related design and requirement docs, project rules
Additive feature detection via feature_type temporary-feature in traced requirement or design docs
Plans carry no frontmatter, so its absence must not be flagged
P2 contradiction checks with exclusion of intentional differences in additive features
P3 unnecessary complexity check against spec priorities, answered Yes/No
tasks: Choosing which reference documents to check in a plan review
Deciding fix, create_issue or skip for a plan review finding
Judging whether a plan belongs to an additive feature
Checking contradictions between a plan and requirements or design
